label: PHASE_M_METHOD_FREEZE_V1
reason: L1 (YOLOv8n, freeze=10 layers, 100 epoch budget, early-stopped at epoch 25 with best at epoch 5) achieves mAP50=0.766, recall=1.0 on DEVELOPMENT val split (3 dive-level held-out dives, 8 frames). Criterion: max(mAP50) > 2 × frozen F1 IoU50 recall (0.083). Threshold: 0.166. Result: VIABLE. L2 (all layers fine-tuned) achieves mAP50≈0.388 peak — worse than L1, confirming that frozen backbone is more appropriate for 28-image micro-dataset (catastrophic forgetting risk).

L2_metrics_peak.note: all layers fine-tuned; overfits; worse than L1 on tiny dataset

caveat: Val set = 8 images from 3 dives (133, 311, 2387) — same domain as train. Production generalization unknown; requires larger validation. Fine-tuned model still limited by 360p proxy scale for original-resolution inference.
